answer: An agent network auditing sparrow counts in a grove can deter Sybil attacks via hardware remote attestation. Each agent generates its key inside a trusted enclave and submits a signed quote chained to a fused silicon root before a challenge horizon expires. Since manufacturer certificates bind quotes to distinct silicon dies, each fake identity demands dedicated physical hardware. However, side-channel key extraction or bulk cloud enclave rentals still let attackers scale Sybils.
